name: Outlanders VR
summary:
Welcome to the Outlands! 

A faraway place where work is hard but rewarding, where people dream big but stay grounded, where friends become family, and settlements become cities.

It’s up to you to use the extensive catalog of tools and buildings at your disposal to guide them towards their goals.
Outlanders are individuals. Simple folk with hopes, dreams, and desires.
